preconditions.description: The lengths of s_1, s_2, and virus must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in s_1) and all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in s_2) and all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in virus)
preconditions.description: All characters in s_1, s_2, and virus must be uppercase English letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '0' if not any(c in s_1 and c in s_2 for c in set(s_1) & set(s_2)) else True
postconditions.description: If there is no common character between s_1 and s_2, output 0.
The output must be the longest common subsequence of s_1 and s_2 that does not contain virus as a substring.
